openingLog: THE THORNLORD awakens! Ancient guardian of the Verdant Shard.
Walls of bark and root rise from the earth — prepare for a siege!

trait.name: Burrow
trait.description: When the Thornlord reaches 50% HP it sinks into the earth, becoming untargetable for 3 seconds. It then erupts from the ground at a random position on the battlefield, dealing 5 AOE damage to all player units within 2 tiles of the landing point.
trait.announceText: The Thornlord BURROWS! Watch the earth — it will rise again!
trait.surfaceText: The earth SPLITS — the Thornlord erupts!

openingLog: WARLORD KRAGG takes the field! Iron discipline, iron walls, iron will.
The siege weapons are already loaded. The gate does not open for you.

trait.name: Earthshaker
trait.description: Every 30 seconds Kragg leaps into the air with a thunderous war cry and crashes down on the player's side of the battlefield. The impact deals 8 AOE damage to all player units within 2 tiles of the landing point and stuns them for 1.5 seconds.
trait.announceText: KRAGG LEAPS — brace for impact!
trait.landText: BOOM — the ground shakes! Units near the crater are stunned!

openingLog: THE ASHWALKER stirs. The ash rises. The dead remember.
An undying horde answers the call — destroy them before they overwhelm you!

trait.name: Ashen Split
trait.description: When the Ashwalker reaches 50% HP it dissolves into a cloud of ash and reforms as 3 identical copies scattered across the battlefield. Each copy has HP equal to one third of the Ashwalker's HP at the time of splitting. All 3 copies must be destroyed to win the battle.
trait.announceText: The Ashwalker SPLITS — three shadows rise from the ash! Destroy them all!
trait.splitLog: The ash swirls… three shapes emerge across the field. Destroy them ALL!

openingLog: THE ARCHIVIST opens the archive. Every spell in the Dominion catalogue — ready.
Arcane constructs flood the field. At turn eight, his mana becomes limitless — act fast!

trait.name: Arcane Ascension
trait.description: When the Archivist's unlimited-mana phase begins (120 s into the battle) he ascends into the air in a column of arcane light, becoming invulnerable for 5 seconds. He then descends at the centre of the battlefield in an arcane shockwave that silences all player units (delays their attacks) for 3 seconds.
trait.announceText: The Archivist ASCENDS — arcane light blinds the field!
trait.landText: ARCANE SHOCKWAVE — all units are silenced!

phases.announceOnce: THE ARCHIVE OPENS — The Archivist's mana becomes limitless!

openingLog: THE TIDAL SOVEREIGN surfaces. The reef shudders. The deep comes with it.
Wave after wave crashes ashore — hold your ground or be dragged under!

trait.name: Riptide Surge
trait.description: When the Tidal Sovereign reaches 50% HP it dives into the depths, becoming untargetable for 3 seconds. It resurfaces at the opposite end of the battlefield accompanied by a crashing wave that pushes all player units back 3 tiles and deals 3 damage to each one.
trait.announceText: The Tidal Sovereign DIVES — a massive wave is incoming!
trait.surfaceText: RIPTIDE! The wave crashes — all units are pushed back!

openingLog: THE PALE ENGINE engages. Cold logic. No retreat. No mercy.
Walls first, then siege fire — don't let the turrets establish themselves.

trait.name: Overload Cascade
trait.description: Every 45 seconds the Pale Engine overloads its power core and discharges an electromagnetic pulse along a random column of the battlefield. All player units in that column take 6 damage and have their attack speed halved for 4 seconds.
trait.announceText: OVERLOAD IMMINENT — the Engine's core destabilises!
trait.fireText: EMP CASCADE — a column of the field is devastated!

openingLog: THE DUNE BARON fields his forces. This is business. He takes it seriously.
Expensive units first, then structures to hold ground — the Baron invests to win.

trait.name: Sand Dive
trait.description: At 66% HP and again at 33% HP the Dune Baron plunges into the sand, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. He resurfaces directly adjacent to the player's highest-HP unit, dealing 4 AOE damage to all player units within 1 tile of the landing spot and disorienting them for 2 seconds.
trait.announceText: The Baron VANISHES into the sand — where will he surface?
trait.surfaceText: He ERUPTS from the dunes — your strongest unit is the target!

openingLog: THE ROOT QUEEN stirs. The network connects. Everything down here is already hers.
Waves of crawlers first — then the deep growth. Don't let the spawners take root.

trait.name: Mycelium Fracture
trait.description: When the Root Queen reaches 40% HP her body dissolves into spores and four Spore Nodes erupt at the four corners of the battlefield. Each Spore Node has 25% of her HP at the time of fracturing. All four nodes must be destroyed to win. The nodes each continue to spawn weak crawler units while alive.
trait.announceText: The Root Queen FRACTURES — Spore Nodes erupt at the four corners!
trait.splitLog: Four Spore Nodes emerge at the corners of the field. Destroy them ALL to win!

openingLog: THE CINDERWARLORD commands the caldera! He and the volcanoes have an understanding.
Early waves are fast and cheap — brace for the heavy assault once the forge fires up!

trait.name: Caldera Leap
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the Cinderwarlord leaps into a nearby volcano vent, disappearing from the battlefield and becoming invulnerable for 4 seconds. He then crashes back down as a blazing meteor at a random point on the player's side of the field, dealing 10 AOE damage in a large 3-tile radius and leaving a burning ground patch that deals 2 damage per second for 5 seconds.
trait.announceText: The Cinderwarlord DIVES into the volcano — incoming eruption!
trait.landText: METEOR IMPACT — the ground ignites! Stay out of the burn zone!

openingLog: THE CLOUDMARSHAL takes position. The sky belongs to the Dominion.
Aerial squadrons in formation — watch above as well as ahead!

trait.name: Storm Dive
trait.description: When the Cloudmarshal reaches 60% HP he ascends into the storm clouds, becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds while his aerial squadrons continue to fight. He then dives at the most densely populated area of the player's side, dealing 7 AOE damage to all units in a 2-tile radius and creating a storm zone that persists for 6 seconds, dealing 2 damage per second to any player unit that remains inside it.
trait.announceText: The Cloudmarshal ASCENDS — he's calling in the storm strike!
trait.landText: STORM DIVE — the impact zone crackles with lightning!

openingLog: THE ELDER WARDEN descends from the canopy. Ancient. Patient. Immovable.
The canopy does not attack. It reclaims. Expect walls, roots, and something very large.

trait.name: Root Surge
trait.description: At 50% HP the Elder Warden drives its roots into the earth, sending a shockwave along a random column. All player units in that column take 6 damage and are rooted (movement stopped) for 3 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE ELDER WARDEN PLUNGES ITS ROOTS — the ground trembles!
trait.fireText: The roots tear through the column — units are rooted!

phases.announceOnce: THE CANOPY AWAKENS — the Elder Warden calls everything to battle!

openingLog: THE HARBORMASTER raises his iron signal flag.
No permit. No passage.

trait.name: Tidal Surge
trait.description: At 50% HP the Harbormaster calls the tide — he vanishes for 2.5 seconds then a wall of water crashes across the battlefield, dealing 10 damage to all player units and pushing them back 2 tiles.
trait.announceText: The Harbormaster calls the tide — BRACE YOURSELF!
trait.surfaceText: A wall of water crashes across the battlefield!

phases.announceOnce: The Harbormaster signals his fleet!
The iron tide rises! No mercy!

openingLog: THE GRAND AUTOMATON engages its threat protocols.
VAULT INTEGRITY: CRITICAL.

trait.name: Gear Cascade
trait.description: At 50% HP the Grand Automaton releases a cascade of spinning gears down a random column, dealing 8 damage to all player units in that column and slowing their attacks for 3 seconds.
trait.announceText: GEAR CASCADE INITIATED — the Automaton releases its payload!
trait.fireText: Gears shred through the column — units slow to a crawl!

phases.announceOnce: ESCALATING TO THREAT LEVEL: MAXIMUM.
ACTIVATING FINAL PROTOCOL. VAULT WILL NOT FALL.

openingLog: THE FRACTURE awakens. The wound at the world's heart tears open.
This is the end. Yours, or the Fracture's.

trait.name: Void Tear
trait.description: At 65% and again at 35% HP, the Fracture tears open a void rift and vanishes for 4 seconds. It then crashes back down onto the player's densest cluster, dealing 8 AOE damage in a 3-tile radius and silencing all hit units for 2 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE FRACTURE TEARS OPEN — reality dissolves around you!
trait.landText: Reality SNAPS back — the void shockwave tears through your ranks!

phases.announceOnce: THE FRACTURE DEEPENS. REALITY BENDS.
THE CORE SHATTERS. THERE IS NO STOPPING THIS.

openingLog: An elite guardian of the Verdant Shard blocks the path.
The roots run deep here.

trait.name: Burrow Strike
trait.description: At 50% HP the guardian sinks underground then erupts at a random position, dealing 4 AOE damage.
trait.announceText: The guardian sinks into the earth!
trait.surfaceText: The ground erupts beneath your feet!

openingLog: An elite Iron Citadel commander bars your advance.
Expect walls and siege fire.

trait.name: Iron Leap
trait.description: Every 35 seconds the commander leaps and crashes down on the player's side, dealing 6 AOE damage and stunning nearby units for 1.5 seconds.
trait.announceText: Iron might descends upon you!

openingLog: An Ashen Wastes champion rises from the cinders.
The dead don't tire.

trait.name: Ash Wave
trait.description: At 40% HP the champion disperses into ash for 2 seconds, then a choking wave deals 3 damage to all player units and pushes them back.
trait.announceText: The Ashen champion disperses into dust!
trait.surfaceText: Ash and bone rain down — your units are pushed back!

openingLog: A Crystal Spire sentinel activates its ward protocols.
Arcane constructs and silence await.

trait.name: Arcane Silence
trait.description: 60 seconds into the fight the sentinel ascends for 3 seconds then descends at the battlefield centre, silencing all player units for 2 seconds.
trait.announceText: The arcane sentinel reaches full power — silence descends!
trait.landText: Arcane silence! Your units are stunned!

openingLog: A Sunken Reef champion surges from the depths.
The reef provides cover for its waves.

trait.name: Riptide
trait.description: At 50% HP the champion dives under for 2 seconds then a wave crashes down, dealing 4 damage to all player units and pushing them back 2 tiles.
trait.announceText: A riptide surges — the wave is incoming!
trait.surfaceText: The wave CRASHES — all units pushed back!

openingLog: A Sky Dominion ace drops from the clouds.
Aerial and fast — keep your ranged units ready.

trait.name: Lightning Column
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the ace calls a lightning strike down a random column, dealing 5 damage and slowing hit units for 3 seconds.
trait.announceText: Lightning strikes from above!
trait.fireText: A bolt of sky energy scorches the column!

openingLog: A Fungal Deep overseer emerges from the mycelium.
The spore network is everywhere.

trait.name: Spore Burst
trait.description: Every 45 seconds the overseer erupts a spore column, dealing 4 damage to all units in the column and slowing them for 4 seconds.
trait.announceText: Spores burst from the elite!
trait.fireText: Units caught in the spore cloud slow to a crawl!

openingLog: A Scorched Expanse warlord strides from the dunes.
Fast and relentless — the desert does not tire.

trait.name: Sand Strike
trait.description: At 50% HP the warlord dives into sand for 2 seconds then erupts next to the player's highest-HP unit, dealing 4 AOE damage.
trait.announceText: The warlord vanishes into the sand!
trait.surfaceText: Sand erupts — the warlord strikes from below!

openingLog: A herald of the Fracture blocks your path to the core.
It carries a shard of the void.

trait.name: Void Pulse
trait.description: At 60% HP the herald tears a void rift and vanishes for 3 seconds, then crashes down onto the player's densest cluster dealing 6 AOE damage and silencing units for 2 seconds.
trait.announceText: A void rift tears open around the herald!
trait.landText: The void pulse detonates — your units are silenced!

openingLog: An officer of Amarath's vanguard bars the road.
Expect disciplined lines and vigil fire.

trait.name: Vigil Rally
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the officer sounds the vigil horn and drops on the player's side in a burst of candle-fire — 5 AOE damage and a 1.2 second stun in a 2-tile radius.
trait.announceText: The vigil horn sounds — the officer charges your line!

idleMessage: The Herald reads on from the writ…
openingLog: THE PALE HERALD unfurls the writ of return.
"Hear the claim of Amarath, Worldmender."

trait.name: Proclamation Descent
trait.description: At 50% HP the Herald ascends into the mist on pale wings (4 s untargetable), then descends onto the player's densest cluster with the full weight of the proclamation — 7 AOE damage in a 2-tile radius.
trait.announceText: The Herald rises into the mist — the proclamation is not finished!
trait.landText: The writ comes down like a verdict — the mist detonates!

phases.announceOnce: "The Marches were only the first name on the writ."
"AMARATH REMEMBERS. LET THAT BE THE LAST LINE."

idleMessage: The scale on his belt does not move on its own…
openingLog: THE TOLL WARDEN plants his standard at the causeway's centre.
"Every traveller pays. You will not be the exception, Worldmender."

trait.name: Toll of the Mile
trait.description: Every 45 seconds the causeway itself exacts its toll — a column of buried milestones ignites underfoot, dealing 7 damage to all units caught in that column and slowing them for 4 seconds.
trait.announceText: The causeway stones begin to glow underfoot — the toll is due!
trait.fireText: THE TOLL IS PAID — a column of the causeway ignites!

phases.announceOnce: "The Marches were only the toll road's threshold."
"NO TRAVELLER PASSES UNWEIGHED. PAY, OR BE WEIGHED ANYWAY."

idleMessage: The wheat around her does not stop moving…
openingLog: THE GLEANER QUEEN rises from the memory-wheat, sickle in hand.
"The Court sent a Herald to announce us, and a Warden to collect. It sent me to glean what's left, Worldmender."

trait.name: Effigy Harvest
trait.description: At 50% HP the Gleaner Queen scatters into three harvest effigies bound from straw and stolen memory, each carrying a third of her HP. All three effigies must fall to win the battle.
trait.announceText: The Gleaner Queen SCATTERS — three harvest effigies rise from the wheat! Fell them all!
trait.splitLog: Straw and sickles reshape themselves into three effigies across the field. Destroy them ALL!

phases.announceOnce: "The causeway only taught you to pay. The field will teach you to be gleaned."
"EVERY SHEAF REMEMBERS A NAME THE WORLD DROPPED. YOURS WILL MAKE A FINE ADDITION."

idleMessage: The dark between the shelves does not stay still…
openingLog: THE NAME-EATER rises from between the deep stacks, ink-dark and crowned in loose pages.
"The Queen gleaned what the world dropped. I keep what the world was made to forget. The Court calls me both prisoner and librarian. Ask it which, and it will change the subject."

trait.name: Between the Shelves
trait.description: At 66% and 33% HP the Name-Eater slips between the shelves — untargetable for a stretch — then resurfaces beside the player's strongest unit, landing hard enough to jolt everything nearby.
trait.announceText: THE NAME-EATER slips BETWEEN THE SHELVES — the stacks close over it!
trait.landText: It resurfaces at your strongest unit's shoulder, and the shelves around it slam shut.

phases.announceOnce: "The fields taught you to be gleaned. The Archive will teach you to be shelved."
"EVERY REGISTER IN THIS HALL REMEMBERS A NAME THE WORLD ERASED. YOURS WILL MAKE A FINE ADDITION."

openingLog: THE LAMPLIGHTER GENERAL steps into the light of ten thousand vigil flames, wick-scepter in hand.

"The Name-Eater kept what the Court could not bear to lose. I keep what the Court will not let stay lit. Three centuries of drill taught this company one doctrine: light on command, dark on command. You are neither."

trait.name: Wax-Fall
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the General raises her wick-scepter and snuffs the district overhead — a wax-fall crashes down on the player's densest cluster, dealing 8 AOE damage in a 2-tile radius and stunning survivors for 1.5 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE LAMPLIGHTER GENERAL calls the wax-fall — the sky over your line goes dark!
trait.landText: Molten wax crashes down, and the flames it smothers do not relight.

phases.announceOnce: "The Archive shelved what it lost. This city lights what it's owed. You are neither owed nor shelved, Worldmender. You are curfew business."
"TEN THOUSAND FLAMES, AND NOT ONE OF THEM ASKS PERMISSION TO GO OUT. NEITHER WILL YOU."

idleMessage: The tide waits for no doctrine…
openingLog: THE DROWNED ENVOY steps from the waterline, retinue in tow, tide rising with every stride.
"The General kept her doctrine lit. I keep a tide that doesn't ask permission to rise. Let's see which one of us the Court still needs, Worldmender."

trait.name: Returning Tide
trait.description: At 50% HP the Envoy dives beneath the waterline, untargetable for 3 seconds, then rides a returning tide onto the player's densest cluster — 7 damage to every unit caught in the wave, pushed back 3 tiles.
trait.announceText: THE DROWNED ENVOY dives beneath the waterline — the tide is turning!
trait.surfaceText: The tide RETURNS, and it does not return alone.

phases.announceOnce: "The General held a city with doctrine. I hold a coastline with a tide that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are toll business."
"THE WATER TAKES WHAT IT'S OWED AND GIVES BACK WHAT IT PLEASES. SO WILL I."

idleMessage: The water does not blink first…
openingLog: THE REFLECTION rises from the still water, wearing the Dominion's face the way it looked before the Fracture.
"The Envoy gave you a tide. I give you a world that remembers not being broken. Let's see which one of us the Court still needs, Worldmender."

trait.name: Shattered Surface
trait.description: When the Reflection reaches 50% HP the still water shatters and it steps out of the surface as three identical copies, each with a third of its HP at the time of splitting, scattered across the battlefield. All three must be destroyed to win.
trait.announceText: THE REFLECTION shatters — the water gives back three of itself!
trait.landText: Each copy remembers the same world. Each one has to be told twice.

phases.announceOnce: "The Envoy held a coastline with a tide. I hold a memory with a stillness that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are a reflection's business."
"THE WATER REMEMBERS WHAT YOU MENDED AND WHAT YOU BROKE FIRST. SO DO I."

idleMessage: The ceremony does not pause for you…
openingLog: THE CHAMBERLAIN raises a gloved hand, and the Hollow Court's masks all turn to face the Worldmender at once.
"The Reflection showed you a world. I show this Court a ceremony instead. Let's see which one of us you find harder to unmake."

trait.name: Erasing Gesture
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the Chamberlain completes a single courtly gesture, and a column of the battlefield is struck from the ceremony's record — 7 damage to all player units caught in that column, slowed for 4 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE CHAMBERLAIN completes a gesture — a column is being erased from the ceremony!
trait.fireText: THE GESTURE IS COMPLETE — a column of the field is struck from the record!

phases.announceOnce: "The Reflection held a memory with a stillness. I hold a ceremony with a gesture that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are a name still being decided."
"EVERY CEREMONY DECIDES WHAT STILL DESERVES A NAME. SO DO I."

idleMessage: The stored cold does not thaw for anyone…
openingLog: THE FROST REGENT rises from the rimed threshold, three centuries of stored winter finally given somewhere to go.
"The Chamberlain gave you a ceremony. I give you a season the Court kept in storage for exactly this crossing. Let's see if you were worth the wait, Worldmender."

trait.name: Waited Blizzard
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the Frost Regent releases a fraction of the waited winter down a random column, dealing 7 damage to all player units caught in that column and slowing them for 4 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE FROST REGENT releases the waited winter — a column is about to freeze!
trait.fireText: THE BLIZZARD ARRIVES — a column of the field is buried in stored cold!

phases.announceOnce: "The Chamberlain held a Court with a gesture. I hold a season with a cold that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are the reason this winter finally moves."
"THREE CENTURIES OF STORAGE DECIDE WHAT A SEASON IS FOR. SO DO I."

idleMessage: The rows do not stop growing for anyone…
openingLog: THE ORCHARD KEEPER rises from among the bonewood rows, shears in hand, every grave in the grove watching with her.
"The Regent kept a season. I keep a kingdom's dead, and I have tended every one of them longer than she tended her cold. Let's see if you're worth planting, Worldmender."

trait.name: The Orchard Rises
trait.description: When the Orchard Keeper reaches 40% HP she plants herself among the rows, and four saplings erupt at the four corners of the battlefield, each with a quarter of her HP at the time of planting. All four saplings must be felled to win.
trait.announceText: THE ORCHARD KEEPER plants herself — four saplings rise from the corners!
trait.landText: Each sapling remembers the same grove. Each one has to be felled in turn.

phases.announceOnce: "The Regent held a season with a cold. I hold a grove with a grief that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are a row still waiting to be tended."
"EVERY GRAVE IN THIS ORCHARD DECIDES WHAT TENDING MEANS. SO DO I."

idleMessage: The vigil does not break step for anyone…
openingLog: THE PROCESSION MASTER falls into step at the head of a column that has marched the same road for three centuries.
"The Keeper gave you a grief to tend. I give you a rite that has outlasted every reason it was started for. Let's see if you can keep pace, Worldmender."

trait.name: The Procession Marches
trait.description: Every 40 seconds the Procession Master leads the column in a leap through the player's densest cluster, dealing 8 AOE damage in a 2-tile radius and stunning survivors for 1.5 seconds.
trait.announceText: THE PROCESSION MASTER calls the march — the column surges toward your line!
trait.landText: THE PROCESSION ARRIVES — it does not stop for anyone in its way.

phases.announceOnce: "The Keeper held a grove with a grief. I hold a road with a vigil that has never once needed telling twice. You are neither owed nor doctrine, Worldmender. You are a mile still being counted."
"EVERY VIGIL DECIDES WHAT THE ROAD IS STILL FOR. SO DO I."
